name: Production and Operations Management in Textile Industry
description: Production and operations management functions, investment decisions and evaluation techniques, payback period, ARR, NPV, IRR; facility location and facility layout, job shop, flow shop and cellular layouts, assembly line balancing; forecasting, qualitative and quantitative techniques; inventory management, inventory policies, economic order quantity models with and without shortages; aggregate production planning, strategies, LP model; materials requirement planning, bill of materials; scheduling of operations, algorithms for job shop and flow shop scheduling; project management, AOA and AON, network diagram, CPM and PERT; quality management, control charts, cost of quality, quality; supply chain management.
